138|def plain_checks(model, variants):
139|    """Greedy tokens over TOKENS steps and one step's kernel count, per variant."""
140|    from mlx_lm.models.cache import make_prompt_cache
141|
142|    out = {}
143|    for rows in (1, 32):
144|        tokens = {}
145|        for name in variants.names:
146|            variants.apply(name)
147|            mx.random.seed(rows)
148|            ids = mx.random.randint(0, 100000, (rows, 128))
149|            cache = make_prompt_cache(model)
150|            seq = [bd.prefill(model, ids, cache)]
151|            for _ in range(TOKENS - 1):
152|                seq.append(bd.greedy(model(seq[-1], cache=cache)))
153|                mx.eval(seq[-1])
154|            tokens[name] = mx.concatenate(seq, axis=1).tolist()
155|            out[(name, rows)] = rf.count_ops([model(seq[-1], cache=cache)])
156|        for name in variants.names[1:]:
157|            out[(name, rows)]["exact"] = tokens[name] == tokens["base"]
158|            out[(name, rows)].update(rf.divergence(tokens[name], tokens["base"]))
159|    variants.apply("base")
160|    return out
161|
162|
163|def against(c, b):
164|    """Two (min, max) ranges of a time: "faster" when c's lies below b's, "slower" above."""
165|    return "faster" if c[1] < b[0] else "slower" if c[0] > b[1] else "same"
166|
167|
168|def g3(log, names, settings, out):
169|    """Each muse-* variant against base and its compiled-* counterpart, from *log*'s vLLM runs."""
170|    runs = [r for r in map(json.loads, log.open()) if r["kind"] == "run" and r["engine"] == "vllm"]
171|
172|    def ranges(name, rows, prompt):
173|        rs = [r for r in runs if (r["variant"], r["rows"], r["prompt"]) == (name, rows, prompt)]
174|        return {m: (min(r[k] for r in rs), max(r[k] for r in rs)) for m, k in MEASURES.items()}
175|
176|    verdict = {}
177|    for name in [n for n in names if n.startswith("muse-")]:
178|        verdict[name] = {}
179|        for bar in ("base", "compiled-" + name.removeprefix("muse-")):
180|            settings_v = {
181|                f"{rows}x{prompt}": {
182|                    m: against(c, b)
183|                    for (m, c), b in zip(ranges(name, rows, prompt).items(), ranges(bar, rows, prompt).values())
184|                }
185|                for rows, prompt in settings
186|            }
187|            phases = {
188|                m: "faster" if all(v[m] == "faster" for v in settings_v.values())
189|                else "slower" if any(v[m] == "slower" for v in settings_v.values())
190|                else "not slower"
191|                for m in MEASURES
192|            }
193|            passes = "faster" in (phases["decode"], phases["prompt"]) and "slower" not in phases.values()
194|            verdict[name][bar] = {"pass": passes, "phases": phases, "settings": settings_v}
195|            print(f"G3 {name} vs {bar}: {'pass' if passes else 'fail'} {phases}")
196|        verdict[name]["g3"] = all(v["pass"] for v in verdict[name].values())
197|    out.write_text(json.dumps(verdict, indent=1) + "\n")
198|
199|
200|def main():
201|    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.split("\n")[0])
202|    ap.add_argument("engine", choices=("plain", "vllm"))
203|    ap.add_argument("out", type=Path)
204|    ap.add_argument(
205|        "attempts", nargs="+", type=attempt_arg, metavar="SLOT=FOLDER",
206|        help="the Muse agent's attempt folder per slot",
207|    )
208|    ap.add_argument(
209|        "--variant", type=variant_arg, action="append", default=[],
210|        metavar="NAME:SLOT=FOLDER[+SLOT=FOLDER...]",
211|        help="another set of attempts to time, outside muse-all",
212|    )
213|    ap.add_argument("--tokens", type=int, default=256, help="output tokens per run")
214|    ap.add_argument("--repeats", type=int, default=G3_REPEATS, help="shuffled repeats per variant and setting")
215|    ap.add_argument(
216|        "--settings", default=G3_SETTINGS, metavar="ROWSxPROMPT,...",
217|        help="request counts and prompt lengths to time (G3: the default)",
218|    )
219|    args = ap.parse_args()
220|    settings = [tuple(int(n) for n in s.split("x")) for s in args.settings.split(",")]
221|    taken = [p for slot, _ in args.attempts for p in parts(slot)]
222|    if len(taken) != len(set(taken)):
223|        ap.error(f"two attempts replace the same part: {sorted(taken)}")
224|    gpu_lock.hold(
225|        f"time_candidates.py {args.engine} "
226|        + " ".join(f"{s}={f}" for s, f in args.attempts)
227|    )
228|    args.out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
229|    log = args.out / f"muse-{args.engine}.jsonl"
230|
231|    if args.engine == "plain":
232|        from mlx_lm.utils import load_model
233|
234|        model, _ = load_model(Path(bd.MODEL))
235|        mx.eval(model.parameters())
236|        variants = Variants(args.attempts, args.variant)
237|        checks = plain_checks(model, variants)
238|        run = lambda r, p, s: bd.run_plain(model, r, p, args.tokens, s)  # noqa: E731
239|    else:
240|        from vllm import LLM
241|
242|        bd.install_vllm_step_hooks()
243|        llm = LLM(
244|            model=bd.MODEL,
245|            trust_remote_code=True,
246|            max_model_len=2048,
247|            max_num_seqs=32,
248|            max_num_batched_tokens=2048,
249|            # 32 rows x 384 tokens need 240 MiB; 32 x 1,280 need 800 MiB
250|            kv_cache_memory_bytes=(1 << 30) if max(p for _, p in settings) > 128 else 512 << 20,
251|            enable_prefix_caching=False,
252|            generation_config="vllm",
253|        )
254|        run = lambda r, p, s: bd.run_vllm(llm, r, p, args.tokens, s)  # noqa: E731
255|        run(1, 16, 0)  # warm-up; captures the runner
256|        variants = Variants(args.attempts, args.variant)
257|        checks = rf.vllm_checks(llm, variants)
258|
259|    rf.time_variants(args.engine, variants, checks, run, log, settings, args.repeats)
260|    if args.engine == "vllm":
261|        g3(log, variants.names, settings, args.out / "g3-vllm.json")
262|
263|
264|if __name__ == "__main__":
265|    main()

1|"""The round's submission check: one pinned end-to-end run, judged like G3.
2|
3|PROTOTYPE for design-lab/designer-a (design: "one gate"). Proposed real
4|location: bench/grader/check_submission.py. It changes no tracked file; it
5|delegates the GPU work to bench/grader/time_candidates.py with pinned
6|arguments, then audits the log and the G3 verdict.
7|
8|  python check_submission.py <out dir> <SLOT=FOLDER>... [--dry-run]
9|
10|What it pins (the G3 rule of claude/adr/0011-decode-and-prefill.md:36-41):
11|engine vllm, 4 workloads (1x128, 8x128, 32x128, 32x1024), 5 repeats,
12|256 tokens, every submitted slot passed positionally in one call so
13|muse-all is measured as a combination, no --variant extras.
14|
15|What it adds over calling time_candidates.py directly:
16|- the free flags (--repeats, --settings, --tokens, --variant) do not exist,
17|  so the run cannot be shrunk or widened by accident or design;
18|- the end-to-end token check (exact greedy tokens at 1 and 32 requests,
19|  the brief's G2) becomes a gate: time_candidates.py logs `exact` but
20|  never judges it (time_candidates.py:168-197 reads only kind=="run");
21|- the audit replays the log: every expected (variant, rows, prompt, rep)
22|  run present, engine vllm, then every judged muse-* variant's g3 pass.
23|
24|It writes <out>/submission-verdict.json (the file the swarm cites) and:
25|- exit 0 with PASS lines: every judged variant passes vs base and its
26|  compiled-* bar, with exact tokens;
27|- exit 1: a variant fails (verdict FAIL, still written);
28|- exit 2: usage error or the log is incomplete (never cite it).
29|
30|The GPU lock is taken by time_candidates.py (time_candidates.py:224);
31|--dry-run prints the pinned command and touches nothing.
32|"""
33|
34|import argparse
35|import json
36|import sys
37|from pathlib import Path
38|
39|# Pinned G3 shape. Must equal time_candidates.G3_SETTINGS / G3_REPEATS and
40|# the --tokens default; main() asserts that before delegating, so drift fails
41|# loudly instead of silently running a different check.
42|EXPECTED_SETTINGS = ((1, 128), (8, 128), (32, 128), (32, 1024))
43|EXPECTED_REPEATS = 5
44|EXPECTED_TOKENS = 256
45|
46|
47|def expected_variants(slots):
48|    """Variant names one pinned call builds (time_candidates.py:111-132)."""
49|    names = ["base"]
50|    for slot in slots:
51|        names += [f"compiled-{slot}", f"muse-{slot}"]
52|    if len(slots) > 1:
53|        names += ["compiled-all", "muse-all"]
54|    return names
55|
56|
57|def judged_variants(slots):
58|    """Variants the verdict must pass: each muse-<slot>, plus muse-all."""
59|    names = [f"muse-{s}" for s in slots]
60|    if len(slots) > 1:
61|        names.append("muse-all")
62|    return names
63|
64|
65|def audit(out, slots):
66|    """Replay <out>/muse-vllm.jsonl + g3-vllm.json. Returns (verdict, problems).
67|
68|    verdict: {"pass": bool, "variants": {name: {...}}, "params": {...}}.
69|    problems: lines explaining why the log cannot be cited (empty when citable).
70|    """
71|    problems = []
72|    log = out / "muse-vllm.jsonl"
73|    g3file = out / "g3-vllm.json"
74|    if not log.exists():
75|        return None, [f"missing {log}"]
76|    if not g3file.exists():
77|        return None, [f"missing {g3file} (no G3 verdict: not a vllm run?)"]
78|    records = [json.loads(line) for line in log.read_text().splitlines()]
79|    runs = [r for r in records if r.get("kind") == "run"]
80|    checks = [r for r in records if r.get("kind") == "check"]
81|
82|    want = expected_variants(slots)
83|    got = sorted({r["variant"] for r in runs})
84|    if got != sorted(want):
85|        problems.append(f"variants {got}, want {want}")
86|    for r in runs:
87|        if r.get("engine") != "vllm":
88|            problems.append(f"run {r.get('variant')} rep {r.get('rep')}: engine {r.get('engine')!r}, want 'vllm'")
89|            break
90|    for name in want:
91|        for rows, prompt in EXPECTED_SETTINGS:
92|            reps = sorted(
93|                r["rep"]
94|                for r in runs
95|                if (r["variant"], r["rows"], r["prompt"]) == (name, rows, prompt)
96|            )
97|            if reps != list(range(EXPECTED_REPEATS)):
98|                problems.append(
99|                    f"{name} {rows}x{prompt}: reps {reps}, want 0..{EXPECTED_REPEATS - 1}"
100|                )
101|
102|    exact = {}
103|    for name in judged_variants(slots):
104|        for rows in (1, 32):
105|            recs = [
106|                c for c in checks
107|                if (c["variant"], c["rows"]) == (name, rows)
108|            ]
109|            if len(recs) != 1:
110|                problems.append(f"check {name} rows {rows}: {len(recs)} records, want 1")
111|                exact[(name, rows)] = False
112|            else:
113|                exact[(name, rows)] = recs[0].get("exact") is True
114|                if not exact[(name, rows)]:
115|                    problems.append(
116|                        f"check {name} rows {rows}: exact is {recs[0].get('exact')!r}, "
117|                        f"want True ({recs[0].get('rows_differ')} sequences differ)"
118|                    )
119|
120|    g3 = json.loads(g3file.read_text())
121|    verdict = {"params": {
122|        "engine": "vllm", "repeats": EXPECTED_REPEATS, "tokens": EXPECTED_TOKENS,
123|        "settings": [f"{r}x{p}" for r, p in EXPECTED_SETTINGS],
124|        "slots": list(slots),
125|    }, "variants": {}}
126|    allpass = not problems
127|    for name in judged_variants(slots):
128|        v = g3.get(name, {})
129|        bars = {b: v.get(b, {}) for b in ("base", "compiled-" + name.removeprefix("muse-"))}
130|        ok = v.get("g3") is True and all(b.get("pass") is True for b in bars.values())
131|        verdict["variants"][name] = {
132|            "pass": ok and all(exact.get((name, r), False) for r in (1, 32)),
133|            "g3": v.get("g3"),
134|            "bars": {b: bars[b].get("pass") for b in bars},
135|            "phases": {b: bars[b].get("phases") for b in bars},
136|            "exact_1": exact.get((name, 1)), "exact_32": exact.get((name, 32)),
137|        }
138|        allpass = allpass and verdict["variants"][name]["pass"]
139|    verdict["pass"] = allpass
140|    verdict["problems"] = problems
141|    return verdict, problems
142|
143|
144|def main(argv=None):
145|    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.split("\n")[0])
146|    ap.add_argument("out", type=Path)
147|    ap.add_argument("attempts", nargs="+", metavar="SLOT=FOLDER")
148|    ap.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true")
149|    args = ap.parse_args(argv)
150|    slots = [a.partition("=")[0] for a in args.attempts]
151|    if any(not s or "=" not in a for s, a in zip(slots, args.attempts)):
152|        ap.error("give SLOT=FOLDER per submitted slot")
153|
154|    if args.dry_run:
155|        print("pinned run: time_candidates.py vllm"
156|              f" {args.out} {' '.join(args.attempts)}"
157|              f" --repeats {EXPECTED_REPEATS} --tokens {EXPECTED_TOKENS}"
158|              " --settings " + ",".join(f"{r}x{p}" for r, p in EXPECTED_SETTINGS))
159|        print("judged:", " ".join(judged_variants(slots)))
160|        return 0
161|
162|    sys.path.insert(0, str(Path("bench/grader").resolve()))
163|    import time_candidates as tc
164|
165|    assert tc.G3_SETTINGS == ",".join(f"{r}x{p}" for r, p in EXPECTED_SETTINGS), \
166|        f"G3_SETTINGS drifted: {tc.G3_SETTINGS}"
167|    assert tc.G3_REPEATS == EXPECTED_REPEATS, f"G3_REPEATS drifted: {tc.G3_REPEATS}"
168|    sys.argv = ["time_candidates.py", "vllm", str(args.out), *args.attempts,
169|                "--repeats", str(EXPECTED_REPEATS), "--tokens", str(EXPECTED_TOKENS),
170|                "--settings", tc.G3_SETTINGS]
171|    tc.main()
172|    verdict, problems = audit(args.out, slots)
173|    (args.out / "submission-verdict.json").write_text(json.dumps(verdict, indent=1) + "\n")
174|    for line in problems:
175|        print(f"UNCITABLE: {line}")
176|    for name, v in verdict["variants"].items():
177|        print(f"{'PASS' if v['pass'] else 'FAIL'} {name}"
178|              f" g3={v['g3']} bars={v['bars']} exact={v['exact_1']}/{v['exact_32']}")
179|    if problems:
180|        return 2
181|    return 0 if verdict["pass"] else 1
182|
183|
184|if __name__ == "__main__":
185|    sys.exit(main())

1|"""The in-round request-level check (DESIGNER-B PROTOTYPE — not the repo tool).
2|
3|Pinned wrapper around bench/grader/time_candidates.py's vLLM + G3 path:
4|
5|* engine is always vllm; repeats, settings and tokens are pinned to the G3
6|  values (5 / 1x128,8x128,32x128,32x1024 / 256); there is no --variant flag,
7|  so every measured slot combination (muse-all) is judged and nothing escapes
8|  judgment or crashes G3's bar lookup;
9|* after the run it composes ONE verdict file, submit.json, holding the G3
10|  verdict, the end-to-end token-exact gate (which time_candidates.g3 ignores),
11|  a per-cell repeat audit, the invocation record, and the static UNVERIFIED
12|  list of what this check never covers.
13|
14|Usage (live; takes the GPU lock through time_candidates):
15|  .venv/bin/python check_submit.py <out-dir> SLOT=FOLDER [SLOT=FOLDER ...]
16|
17|CPU-only entry points used by the tests:
18|  compose_submit(log_path, g3_path, attempts, out_path, invocation=None)
19|"""
20|
21|import argparse
22|import copy
23|import datetime
24|import json
25|import sys
26|from pathlib import Path
27|
28|REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
29|sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO / "bench" / "grader"))
30|
31|import time_candidates as tc  # noqa: E402  reuse, never a fork of the G3 rule
32|
33|ENGINE = "vllm"
34|REPEATS = tc.G3_REPEATS          # 5
35|SETTINGS = tc.G3_SETTINGS        # "1x128,8x128,32x128,32x1024"
36|TOKENS = 256
37|CHECK_ROWS = (1, 32)             # rows at which greedy tokens must equal base's
38|
39|# What this check never covers (ADR 0011:51 residual + documented noise).
40|UNVERIFIED = [
41|    "prefill chunks of other sizes (only the first chunk at 127/1,016/2,048 rows is graded; G3 runs 128/1,024-token prompts)",
42|    "decode steps with row counts other than 1/8/32",
43|    "request counts and prompt lengths outside the four workloads",
44|    "1-request whole-request time: repeats spread 6-41%, verdicts there are mostly `same` (ADR 0011:52)",
45|    "kernels outside the submitted slots; pairing with future submissions re-measures the combination",
46|]
47|
48|
49|def parse_settings():
50|    return [tuple(int(n) for n in s.split("x")) for s in SETTINGS.split(",")]
51|
52|
53|def expected_names(attempts):
54|    """muse-* variants a run of *attempts* must judge: per slot, plus muse-all."""
55|    names = [f"muse-{slot}" for slot, _ in attempts]
56|    if len(attempts) > 1:
57|        names.append("muse-all")
58|    return names
59|
60|
61|def load_records(log_path):
62|    records = [json.loads(line) for line in Path(log_path).open()]
63|    checks = {(r["variant"], r["rows"]): r for r in records if r["kind"] == "check"}
64|    runs = [r for r in records if r["kind"] == "run" and r["engine"] == ENGINE]
65|    return checks, runs
66|
67|
68|def exact_gate(checks, names):
69|    """{variant: {rows: bool}} for the judged variants; base is exact by definition."""
70|    exact = {}
71|    for name in names:
72|        exact[name] = {}
73|        for rows in CHECK_ROWS:
74|            rec = checks.get((name, rows))
75|            exact[name][str(rows)] = bool(rec and rec.get("exact"))
76|    return exact
77|
78|
79|def repeat_audit(runs, names, settings):
80|    """run counts per (variant, rows, prompt) cell; the pin is 5 everywhere."""
81|    cells = {}
82|    for name in ["base"] + [f"compiled-{n.removeprefix('muse-')}" for n in names
83|                            if not n.endswith("-all")] + names:
84|        for rows, prompt in settings:
85|            n = sum(1 for r in runs
86|                    if (r["variant"], r["rows"], r["prompt"]) == (name, rows, prompt))
87|            cells[f"{name}@{rows}x{prompt}"] = n
88|    # compiled-all exists exactly when muse-all does
89|    if "muse-all" in names:
90|        for rows, prompt in settings:
91|            cells[f"compiled-all@{rows}x{prompt}"] = sum(
92|                1 for r in runs
93|                if (r["variant"], r["rows"], r["prompt"]) == ("compiled-all", rows, prompt))
94|    return cells
95|
96|
97|def medians(runs, names, settings):
98|    """median + [min-max] per judged variant/setting/measure, for MEASURED citations."""
99|    out = {}
100|    for name in names:
101|        out[name] = {}
102|        for rows, prompt in settings:
103|            cell = [r for r in runs
104|                    if (r["variant"], r["rows"], r["prompt"]) == (name, rows, prompt)]
105|            out[name][f"{rows}x{prompt}"] = {
106|                m: {"median": statistics_median([r[k] for r in cell if r.get(k) is not None]),
107|                    "min": min_max([r[k] for r in cell if r.get(k) is not None])[0],
108|                    "max": min_max([r[k] for r in cell if r.get(k) is not None])[1],
109|                    "n": len(cell)}
110|                for m, k in tc.MEASURES.items()
111|            }
112|    return out
113|
114|
115|def statistics_median(xs):
116|    import statistics
117|    return statistics.median(xs) if xs else None
118|
119|
120|def min_max(xs):
121|    return (min(xs), max(xs)) if xs else (None, None)
122|
123|
124|def compose_submit(log_path, g3_path, attempts, out_path, invocation=None):
125|    """Build submit.json from a finished pinned run. No GPU. Raises SystemExit
126|    with a clean message (never a traceback) when the run cannot source a claim."""
127|    names = expected_names(attempts)
128|    verdict = json.loads(Path(g3_path).read_text())
129|    missing = [n for n in names if n not in verdict]
130|    if missing:
131|        raise SystemExit(f"submit: G3 verdict is missing {missing}; "
132|                         f"the combination was not measured as a combination")
133|    checks, runs = load_records(log_path)
134|    settings = parse_settings()
135|    exact = exact_gate(checks, names)
136|    exact_pass = all(all(v.values()) for v in exact.values())
137|    cells = repeat_audit(runs, names, settings)
138|    bad_cells = {c: n for c, n in cells.items() if n != REPEATS}
139|    if bad_cells:
140|        raise SystemExit(f"submit: repeat audit failed (want {REPEATS} everywhere): "
141|                         f"{bad_cells}")
142|    target = "muse-all" if "muse-all" in names else names[0]
143|    submit = {
144|        "check": "submit",
145|        "attempts": {slot: str(folder) for slot, folder in attempts},
146|        "invocation": invocation or {
147|            "engine": ENGINE, "settings": SETTINGS, "repeats": REPEATS,
148|            "tokens": TOKENS, "utc": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)
149|                                    .strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"),
150|        },
151|        "exact": exact,
152|        "exact_pass": exact_pass,
153|        "g3": {n: verdict[n] for n in names},
154|        "target": target,
155|        "target_pass": bool(verdict[target]["g3"]),
156|        "medians": medians(runs, names, settings),
157|        "pass": bool(exact_pass and verdict[target]["g3"]),
158|        "unverified": list(UNVERIFIED),
159|    }
160|    Path(out_path).write_text(json.dumps(submit, indent=1) + "\n")
161|    return submit
162|
163|
164|def main_live():
165|    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.split("\n")[0])
166|    ap.add_argument("out", type=Path)
167|    ap.add_argument("attempts", nargs="+", type=tc.attempt_arg, metavar="SLOT=FOLDER")
168|    args = ap.parse_args()
169|    # The live path reuses time_candidates.main with a pinned argv: the G3 rule
170|    # stays in exactly one place. (Not exercised in designer-b tests: no GPU.)
171|    sys.argv = ["time_candidates.py", ENGINE, str(args.out),
172|                *[f"{s}={f}" for s, f in args.attempts],
173|                "--repeats", str(REPEATS), "--settings", SETTINGS,
174|                "--tokens", str(TOKENS)]
175|    tc.main()
176|    attempts = args.attempts
177|    submit = compose_submit(args.out / f"muse-{ENGINE}.jsonl",
178|                            args.out / "g3-vllm.json", attempts,
179|                            args.out / "submit.json",
180|                            invocation={"engine": ENGINE, "settings": SETTINGS,
181|                                        "repeats": REPEATS, "tokens": TOKENS,
182|                                        "argv": sys.argv,
183|                                        "utc": datetime.datetime.now(
184|                                            datetime.timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")})
185|    print(f"submit: {'pass' if submit['pass'] else 'fail'} "
186|          f"(target {submit['target']}, exact {submit['exact_pass']})")
187|
188|
189|if __name__ == "__main__":
190|    main_live()

import check_gate as cg  # noqa: E402

1|"""One GPU job at a time: the exclusive lock every grader entry point takes.
2|
3|Muse Spark's builder agents and Claude run these scripts on the same M1 Pro
4|GPU, and two runs at once distort each other's timings. A run that finds the
5|GPU busy says so and waits its turn, so runs queue and never overlap. The lock
6|file is in /tmp, so the main checkout and the Muse Spark worktree share it, and
7|the operating system releases it when the process ends, however it ends.
8|"""
9|
10|import fcntl
11|import os
12|import sys
13|
14|LOCK = "/tmp/mobilemoe-gpu.lock"
15|_held = []  # keeps the locked file open for the life of the process
16|
17|
18|def hold(job):
19|    """Take the GPU for this process, waiting while another run has it."""
20|    f = open(LOCK, "a+")
21|    try:
22|        fcntl.flock(f, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
23|    except BlockingIOError:
24|        f.seek(0)
25|        holder = f.read().strip() or "another run"
26|        print(f"{job}: waiting for the GPU ({holder})", file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
27|        fcntl.flock(f, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
28|    f.seek(0)
29|    f.truncate()
30|    f.write(f"pid {os.getpid()}: {job}\n")
31|    f.flush()
32|    _held.append(f)
